description: Source code for the OpenAI Moderation Guardrail integration within the LiteLLM framework. Implements guardrail functionality to detect and block harmful content by interfacing with the OpenAI Moderation API, including pre-call, moderation, post-call, and streaming response hooks.

classes.name: OpenAIModerationGuardrail
classes.description: A guardrail class for integrating OpenAI Content Moderation API to scan prompts and responses for harmful content, with pre-call, moderation, post-call, and streaming hooks.
